concepts.gloss_en: Verse fragment (Psalms 119:109): '...and Your Torah I have not forgotten' — cited as a segula/remedy for memory

reason_for_human: Both occurrences are the identical verse fragment from Psalms 119:109, both vocalized 'וְתוֹרָתְךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי' and both in LM 46 as a memory remedy tied to clapping hands in prayer. The only surface difference is whether the leading vav-conjunction was included in the label — pure prefix variation of the same phrase, not a homograph.
